test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Choose the sentence with no spelling error. **

options.text: I am willing to consider the possibility
I am willing to considerr the possibility
I am wiling to consider the posibility
I am willing to consider the posibility.

solution:
The correct answer is **"I am willing to consider the possibility."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The spelling of all words in this sentence is correct.
 
• **"Consider"** is spelled with only one** "r" **and two **"s's."**
 
• **"Willing"** is spelled with only one **"l."**
 
• **"Possibility" **is spelled with **"i-b-i-l-i-t-y."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2,** "I am willing to considerr the possibility" **has a spelling error in the word **"consider."**
 
• Option 3,** "I am wiling to consider the posibility"** has spelling errors in the words** "willing" **and **"possibility."**
 
• Option 4, **"I am willing to consider the posibility"** has a spelling error in the word **"possibility."**
